rule_description: 多个组件关联同一数据时，建议在组件中使用@Watch装饰器添加更新条件，避免不必要的组件更新。

target_findings.message: This data is associated with multiple components, you are advised to use the @Watch decorator to add update conditions to avoid unnecessary component update.
